note: Single source of truth for artifact classification. The Go site generator (internal/sitegen) embeds this file and the Python dashboard generator (scripts/generate_site_data.py) reads it, so both describe the same filename the same way. Rules are evaluated in order; the first match wins. Precedence is deliberate: all_sources_singbox.json is a Sing-box profile, not the plain-text URI feed, and the order also keeps the .json rule below the profile rules that already matched.
